units.name: Subductor Squad
wargearOptions: The Proctor-Subductor can be equipped with 1 nuncio aquila.

rawRules.name: Dedication to Duty
rawRules.description: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rawRules.name: Nuncio Aquila
rawRules.description: Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, you can select one objective marker within 6" of the bearer. All enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Each objective marker can only be targeted by this ability once per turn. Designer's Note: Place one Nuncio-aquila token next to the bearer, removing it once it uses this ability.

rawRules.name: Masters of Close Confines
rawRules.description: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

units.name: Corvus Blackstar
wargearOptions: This model's twin assault cannon can be replaced with 1 twin lascannon.
This model's 2 Blackstar rocket launchers can be replaced with 2 stormstrike missile launchers.
This model can be equipped with 1 hurricane bolter.
This model can be equipped with one of the following:; 1 auspex array; 1 infernum halo-launcher

rawRules.name: Blackstar Cluster Launcher
rawRules.description: Each time this model ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit it moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 5+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rawRules.name: Auspex Array
rawRules.description: Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

rawRules.name: Infernum Halo-launcher
rawRules.description: The bearer has the Smoke keyword.

rawRules.name: Transport
rawRules.description: This model has a transport capacity of 12 DEATHWATCH INFANTRY models.

rawRules.name: Damaged profile
rawRules.description: 1-5 Wounds Remaining While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
